Post 1
📈 ASX 200 hit a 20-day high Tuesday, closing at 8,947.80 (+53.80pts, +0.60%). Just 2.77% from the 52-week high. Consumer Discretionary led the charge. The index has now gained 1.76% over five sessions. #ASX #ausbiz

Post 2
🟢 Consumer Discretionary +2.68%, Telcos +2.55%, Health Care +2.26%. One outlier: Materials -1.36%, the only sector with real selling pressure. Broad risk-on tone, but miners didn't get the memo. #ASX #mining #ausbiz

Post 3
VEA surged 8.61% to AUD 2.650 — the session's top mover. Viva Energy led the entire ASX 200. Energy sector finished +1.60%. When a fuel retailer tops the leaderboard, something structural is shifting. #ASX #energy #ausbiz

Post 4
🪙 Gold at AUD 5,820.78/oz. Silver AUD 83.07/oz. With Materials the only sector in the red (-1.36%), precious metals aren't translating to miner gains. AUD/USD sitting at 0.6962. #gold #silver #ASX #ausbiz

Post 5
8,947.80 — we're knocking on the door of the 52-week high, just 2.77% away. Can Materials find a bid to close that gap, or does sector divergence stall the rally? Where do you see the ASX by Friday? #ASX #ausbiz
